Administrator 8/21/2020 OUR BRAND & VISION Our Brand 'La Nueva' is inspired by the newness in Latin. La Nueva wishes to bring a dynamic breath of life to the Hanoi Old Quarter. 'N' letter is stylised and is curling; it has been promising to bring the enjoyness and sophistication in serving to our guests. La Nueva Boutique Hotel Hanoi is ideally located and very close to Hoan Kiem Lake. It includes 34 guest rooms and suites with views of Hanoi Old Quarter. For dining options, Momento Restaurant offers a diverse range of Vietnamese and Western cuisine that promises to impress your taste buds at the first bite. Guests can also chill out at our Estrella Sky Bar, taking a sip of our signature cocktails while enjoying a mesmerizing view of the Hoan Kiem Lake. At La Nueva Boutique Hotel Hanoi, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We are committed to delight you with wonderful experiences. Let us bring you a memorable stay in Hanoi. Our Vision La Nueva’s vision is being recognized as one of the best boutique hotel groups in Hanoi Old Quarter. Our Mission La Nueva’s mission is to completely delight and satisfy our guests. We are committed to continual improvement, to making a difference each day and to being the best. Our Guiding Principles Delighting our guests: We are committed to exceeding guest expectations by surprising them with our ability to anticipate and fulfill their wishes. Becoming the best : We intend to be a leader in the boutique hospitality industry. We will continually improve our service delivery, as well as the quality of our products and facilities, ensuring we appeal to the multi-generational audience. Working together: We emphasize the importance of teamwork and treat each other with mutual respect and trust. By working together cooperatively, we all contribute to the future Group's success. Acting with responsibility : We maintain integrity, fairness and honesty in all our internal and external relationships. We support initiatives that improve the environment and are responsible members of our communities.
